Aegon's Dagger is a lesser known Valyrian steel blade owned by House Targaryen whose origins go back to Old Valyria. The hilt is decorated with gold and dragonbone.

Aegon instructed the last surviving Valyrian pyromancers to hide a prophecy into the blade.

I summon my craftsman and order him to bring me an assortment of designs for my new mask. It is time to ditch this horrid mask I am currently using in favor of something more ornate.\n\n"My [ROOT.Char.GetLadyLord|U], what material best suites you?\" He asks, presenting me with several options.

Just as [daenysTarg.GetFirstName] foresaw the end of Valyria, [aegonTarg.GetFirstName] foresaw the end of the world of men. It is to begin with a terrible winter. Gusting out of the distant north. [aegonTarg.GetFirstName] saw absolute darkness riding on those winds, and whatever dwells within will destroy the world of the living. [aegonTarg.GetFirstName] called his dream The Song of Ice and Fire. This secret has been passed from King to heir since.

In the night I take the opportunity to once again gaze into the prophecy.

I read it to myself softly.

"From my blood will come the prince that was promised, and his will be The Song of Ice and Fire"

Such mysterious words, yet they seem strangely familiar.

Perhaps one day I will make sense of it...

As I lower the blade into the flame I once again see the ancient Valyrian glyphs begin to glow...

Glyphs turn to shapes, and my vision becomes unclear. I hear voices and see faces...The flame burns hotter and glyphs shine brighter...

I begin to see dragons, men, women, and cities I've never known, one vision fades into another again and again, as I struggle to focus.

My mind can't bear it all and I begin to hear whispers and then shouting. My blood begins to boil and my vision fades into nothing but a blur of light. My skin feels like it is burning. All I can see and hear is the prohecy..."From my blood will come the prince that was promised...From my blood will come the prince that was promised"

There has always been much mystery surrounding the Valyrian steel dagger that once belonged to [aegonTarg.GetFullName]. Perhaps there is something more to this dagger?

I muster all the books and records I have from [aegonTarg.GetFirstNameNicknamedPossessive] time...and I find nothing except a diary and a sketch of the dagger alongside the Valyrian glyph #COLOR:{1.0,1.0,1.0};FONT:ValyrianGlyphsFont;SIZE:20 J #!which translates to 'Fire'.

"Fire?" I ask myself. I lower the blade into the flame that lights my room and it glows to life with numerous Valyrian glyphs.

With this knowledge I connect the contents of the diary to the words in the blade. [aegonTarg.GetFirstName] saw something... something dark and terrible, and only the heir of [aegonTarg.GetFirstName] can protect the world of men...
"I will return soon my [main.GetTitleTierName]!"\n\nAnd with that, [antiquarian.GetFirstName] is gone, in search of artifacts long lost...

[antiquarian.GetFirstName] returns atlast to my court. I immediately notice [antiquarian.GetSheHe|U] has been through the seven hells...

"My [ROOT.Char.GetTitleAsName]," [antiquarian.GetFirstName] bows deeply, "I bring news and a gift from beyond The Wall."

[antiquarian.GetSheHe|U] presents me a blade once wielded by my ancestors. Dark Sister, one of two Vayrian Steel blades owned by House [main.GetDynasty.GetBaseName]...

It was rumoured that [brynden.GetFirstNameNicknamed] had brought the sword with him to the Nights Watch...it has remained lost beyond the Wall until now.

[antiquarian.GetFirstName] arrives, and with [antiquarian.GetHerHim] is an artifact surrounded with great mystery and intrigue...

"A dagger my [ROOT.Char.GetTitleAsName], made of Valyrian Steel..."

[antiquarian.GetSheHe|U] presents it to me.

[antiquarian.GetSheHe|U] continues, "I've found scarce readings from old letters and books that mention a dagger that once was owned by [aenar.GetTitledFirstName], and eventually [aegonTarg.GetTitledFirstName]...It appears very few times in the writings up until its recorded ownership by [viserys.GetTitledFirstName]...it all but disappeared from the writings after The Dance."

Intriguing, a third Valyrian Steel weapon that belonged to my ancestors? Strange...

I wonder what mystery lies in this dagger...

[antiquarian.GetFirstName] arrives to my courtroom and presents a mighty weapon to me.

"The war hammer of [orys.GetTitledFirstName]...This hammer was wielded by [orys.GetFirstName] following the Conquest...It's rumored that [orys.GetFirstNamePossessive] half brother, [aegonTarg.GetTitledFirstName], gifted it after his conquest."

It had been passed down through the Lords of House [orys.GetDynasty.GetBaseName], but its roots go back to House [aegonTarg.GetDynasty.GetBaseName] as [orys.GetFirstName] was originally a [aegonTarg.GetDynasty.GetBaseName] bastard!

While the hammer now belongs to me, I have no doubt that [baratheon_head.GetTitledFirstName] yearns for this weapon...

Perhaps returning it to House [orys.GetDynasty.GetBaseName] would be a gesture of good will? 

Or maybe it is better kept in the hands of House [main.GetDynasty.GetBaseName]...

[antiquarian.GetFirstName] arrives to my courtroom and presents a mighty gift for me.

"The crown of The Conqueror...May the strength of [aegonTarg.GetTitledFirstName] be reborn in you..."

[aegonTarg.GetTitledFirstName] was crowned with this circlet by his sister wife, [visenya.GetFirstName], following his arrival in Westeros.

It had been passed down from [aegonTarg.GetDynasty.GetBaseName] King to [aegonTarg.GetDynasty.GetBaseName] King until it was lost in Dorne along with [daeron.GetTitledFirstName].

Now it has returned to House [main.GetDynasty.GetBaseName], albeit with the rubies plucked from their sockets...

Perhaps I could pay an artisan to have the crown restored to its former glory?

[antiquarian.GetFirstName] arrives to my courtroom and presents a royal gift to me.

"The crown of [aenys.GetTitledFirstName]...It was lost sometime after the death of [jaehaerys.GetTitledFirstName], but alas now it is found..."

This crown was was worn by the second [main.GetDynasty.GetBaseName] King in Westeros, [aenys.GetTitledFirstName] before his death at the hands of [maegor.GetTitledFirstName].

It has now returned to its rightful owners.

[antiquarian.GetFirstName] arrives at last.

"My [ROOT.Char.GetTitleAsName]! My journey took me far across the Narrow sea to Braavos where I found something that may be of interest to you..."

[antiquarian.GetSheHe|U] presents to me the crown of [jaehaerys.GetTitledFirstName]. It's fate has long been unknown following the Dance of Dragons when [rhae.GetTitledFirstName] sold it to Braavosi merchants.

Now it has been returned to its rightful owners.

[antiquarian.GetFirstName] arrives, and with [antiquarian.GetHerHim] carries a rather small item.

"My [ROOT.Char.GetTitleAsName]! I found something that will interest you greatly...The circlet of the Dowager Queen [visenya.GetFirstName] "

[antiquarian.GetSheHe|U] presents to me small Valyrian Steel band, decorated with small oval shaped rubies.

This circlet is a reminder of the origins of House [aegonTarg.GetDynasty.GetBaseName] as rulers of Westeros.

[antiquarian.GetFirstName] arrives at last, and with [antiquarian.GetHerHim] carries an artifact from my ancestors...

"The crown of [aegon_3.GetTitledFirstName]...A simpler artifact of your house, but one that still carries significant meaning." [antiquarian.GetFirstName] says.

The crown of the Dragonbane marks the transition of House [aegonTarg.GetDynasty.GetBaseName] from dragonlords, to mere mortals, their once-mighty dragons reduced to mere echoes of a bygone era.

[antiquarian.GetFirstName] arrives to my courtroom and presents a an artifact from a bygone era. 

"The crown of [maekar.GetTitledFirstName], returned to your House at last..."

I am presented with a harsh and pointy looking crown which reflects the martial nature of the late [maekar.GetTitledFirstName], who was renowned for both his prowess and martial ability.

The crown now has returned to its home, at last.

Eventually, [antiquarian.GetFirstName] arrives at my court bearing a small item.

 [antiquarian.GetSheHe|U] kneels an presents it to me.

"The mask of the late [viserys.GetTitledFirstName]. A remnant of a time before the Dance of Dragons..."

[antiquarian.GetFirstName] presents a golden mask to me that was once worn by [viserys.GetTitledFirstName] during the last years of his life.

[viserys.GetTitledFirstName] wore the mask in his rare court appearences prior to his death.

[antiquarian.GetFirstName] returns, and with [antiquarian.GetHerHim] is a rather interesting item...

[antiquarian.GetSheHe|U] presents a crown made of flowers to me.

"The mask of the [baelor.GetTitledFirstName] 'the Blessed'.

It is remarkable how this artifact has survived the years...
